title: 2024 Bowman Chrome Mega Box Marco Luciano Mojo Refractor Rookie RC Giants 18
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Bowman Chrome Mega Box contains a variety of sports trading cards, including the rookie card of Marco Luciano, a player for the San Francisco Giants. The cards are from the 2024 season and manufactured by Bowman, a company owned by Topps. The set is part of the Bowman Chrome series and features a chrome finish. 

The cards are perfect for collectors or fans of baseball and come with a range of attributes, such as player, team, and card number. The set does not include any autographed cards or cards with modified features. It is a great addition to any collection or a perfect gift for a fan of the San Francisco Giants.
